objective: reduce both device energy and AP prediction error without replacing the frozen simulator or RL model

conditional_PC_candidate.entry_condition: state-dependent development residuals justify a four-state refit; do not claim it fixes no-load future baseline drift
conditional_PC_candidate.loss: same equally-session-weighted least squares of 5-second development energy intervals after t=35
conditional_PC_candidate.constraints: idle_bias_w fixed zero; four state increments nonnegative; rank4 and positive total power required
conditional_PC_candidate.initialization: original pre50 power from canonical [-20,30]; observed preAP only; no post-load sensor feedback
conditional_PC_candidate.AP: frozen LOAD_SLOW and its original energy proxy unchanged; no new energy coefficient injection
report: CPU_PAR paired delta error and sign
stored A and B schedules separately where available
stops: missing required role or schedule fields
conditional_PC_candidate.success_scope: limited posthoc model improvement if supported; not a policy-superiority or general baseline solution

rejected_shortcuts: permanent positive delta over long idle
permanent pre20 initialization for long future, rejected by long recovery and policy differences
select P20 for C0 and P50 for LOAD after seeing results
invent decay tau or physical ambient/coupling parameters
combine new energy coefficients with already-confirmed AP proxy
treat an online observer with new observations as the same offline prediction task
